And Another on 7 April, 2025 High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:49791 Court No. - 73 Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 27040 of 2024 Applicant :- Gulshan Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Virendra Kumar Gupta Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A. Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J. 1. 2. This is an application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. filed for quashing the entire proceedings of Special Complaint No 15 of 2015 (State vs. Gulshan) under Sections 26/52, 58,59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, P.S. Kulpahad, District Mahoba pending in the court of Additional Sessions Judge, court no.1 Banda as well as summoning order dated 28.05.2015 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Banda.
